::: {.section .section-light}
## About {#about}

Welcome to my personal website!

I'm Professor of Sociology at the University of Texas at Austin. I study how socio-economic transformations produce inequality across a range of settings — financial markets, workplaces, labor markets, and digital platforms — drawing on statistical and computational methods. Across these projects, I work to bring sociological theory and large-scale data into close conversation

I edit Socio-Economic Review, the official journal of the Society for the Advancement of Socio-Economics (SASE).

My current projects ask how large language models can be implemented for social science research, and what prediction markets reveal about the relationship between price and value.

:::
